Nogometni klub Krka, commonly referred to as NK Krka or Krka, is a Slovenian football club based in Novo Mesto, that competes in the Slovenian Second League, the second tier of Slovenian football. The team plays its home games at Portoval. The club was founded in 1922 and was known as NK Elan in the past.
